description: What cancels a CAST — the enum behind the scalar SpellInterrupts.InterruptFlags column only. ITS SIBLING COLUMNS DO NOT SHARE IT: AuraInterruptFlags and ChannelInterruptFlags use SpellInterruptFlags (see spell_interrupt_flags.json), where movement is bit 3 rather than bit 0. Treating the three columns as one enum is a mistake this project has already made once, and it reported the channel population 4.4x too low. Here movement is bit 0. `handler` marks the bits the pack ships.
